channel.title: Video Pulse Review
channel.description: Independent viewing guides for restoration, factory process, and practical engineering videos.

item.title: How I Made This 100-Year-Old Piece Look Brand New | Restoration Process Guide
item.description: This viewing guide accompanies "How I Made This 100-Year-Old Piece Look Brand New" by Casa Amor Furniture - by Camila Johnson. It focuses on how to assess the starting condition, follow the repair choices, and separate a cosmetic finish from a result that restores useful function.
